data.title: Jailer 2
data.hook: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian is back. Does the sequel earn it?
data.hookNote: Spoiler-free: nothing past the first act.

items.heading: Rajinikanth
items.body: **Rajinikanth** does what only he can, and the film knows it. Every entry lands, and he underplays the quieter beats far more than the trailer suggests.

items.heading: Humour & mass moments
items.body: **Nelson** stages the setpieces with real confidence. The comedy is hit and miss, but when it lands the theatre goes up.

items.heading: Story
items.body: The thinnest part. The plot exists to move Pandian between confrontations, and the new threat never feels like one.

items.heading: Pace & editing
items.body: The middle hour drags badly. Twenty minutes could come out and nobody would miss them.

data.verdictS: A star vehicle that works whenever it remembers it is one. Go for Rajinikanth, not the plot.
data.verdictTag: Beyond the Screen. Into the Story.
